name: @papercusp/operator-core
description: Headless operator backend — agent-tools, endpoint-route handlers, harness logic, host composition. Zero UI/React dependency; consumed by apps/operator (the UI package) and the desktop sidecar. Carved from apps/operator in SP1 C4 (plan operator-core-headless-serve-2026-06-04). Resolution is via the consumer's tsconfig path / vite alias (source-only, no build); internal imports are relative.
